| description = The Treants in the northeastern corner of South Karana spawn as a pair and are social with each other, but won't necessarily aggro together when pulled. They also drop several hundred gold, silver, and copper coins per kill.<br><br>
In West Karana they are usually solo, wandering through the hills in the northern part of the zone.  Unfortunately the West Karana Treants do not drop as much coins as the South Karana ones. <br><br>NOTE: As of the Dec 2020 update, treants no longer drop gems. They still drop Lightstones, Great Staffs, and coin, but the gems have been replaced by a likelihood for Wooden Shards. They will still drop research mats, albeit they seem to be '''very, very''' rare.


They cast: [[Ensnaring Roots]], [[Stinging Swarm]], [[Flame Lick]], [[Healing]], [[Ignite]], [[Cancel Magic]], [[Dizzying Wind]], [[Sunbeam]], [[Skin Like Steel]], [[Creeping Crud]]
